summary: TrackMyRMC Phase 1 backend + frontend fully verified. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases passed (health, OTP request/verify with dev_otp, resend throttle 429, wrong OTP -> 400, max-attempts -> 429, unknown-email rejection, admin email OTP OK, /me kyc_status=VERIFIED, customer home shape with RMC-1001 DISPATCHED + 2 recent + 3 verified plants, KYC already-verified -> 409, RBAC 403 for admin on customer endpoints, missing-auth -> 401, logout revokes session -> subsequent /me = 401). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): login hero 'TRACK MY RMC' renders; entering +919000000001 auto-fills dev OTP and verifies to customer home showing RMC-1001 DISPATCHED, 3 nearby plants, KYC VERIFIED banner; Orders tab renders both seeded orders and filter chips (all/pending/accepted/production/dispatched/delivered/cancelled) are present and clickable; Plants tab lists Concrete King, Sky RMC, Prime Mix and search 'Miyapur' filters correctly; More tab renders Profile, Appearance toggle (light/dark/system) and Logout; KYC screen shows 'KYC Verified' with 'YOU CAN PLACE ORDERS USING APP' pill; admin@trackmyrmc.test lands on /role-home (not customer dashboard) as designed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'); consider migrating to lifespan handler (non-blocking).

In tests, the Input component's testID renders on the outer wrapper (not the underlying <input>); if future tests need to type via [data-testid=...] the wrapper should forward testID to the inner TextInput or expose a nested data-testid for the input element. Using get_by_placeholder is a working workaround.

success_rate.backend: 100% (17/17 passed, 1 intentionally skipped - admin has no mobile identifier)

seed_data_creation: None (used dev seed: +919000000001 customer, admin@trackmyrmc.test admin, 3 plants, 2 orders). Auth tests created ephemeral customer accounts via unknown mobile self-registration; these are harmless leftovers in the dev DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Auth via OTP: request-otp returns dev_otp (provider intentionally NOT_CONFIGURED). Use unique random mobile numbers for throttle/max-attempt tests to avoid 30s resend window collisions on the seeded number. For Playwright UI tests on Expo web, the custom Input wrapper does not forward testID to the underlying <input>, so use get_by_placeholder() to fill text. Admin login must be email; customer login must be mobile (channel-per-role policy enforced server-side).
